statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting on 2026-09-16, moving it above the 3.50 to 3.75 percent range held since 2026-07-29.
resolution: FRED series DFEDTARU shows an upper limit above 3.75 percent effective 2026-09-17, matching the FOMC policy statement released 2026-09-16.
failure_condition: The upper limit of the target range stands at 3.75 percent or lower after the 2026-09-16 decision.

statement: Europe Brent spot crude prints at or below 75.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one business day between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: FRED series DCOILBRENTEU carries at least one observation at or below 75.00 with an observation date between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-30.
failure_condition: Every Brent spot observation dated inside the window is above 75.00 US dollars per barrel.

statement: A temporary joint Iran-Oman maritime corridor through the Strait of Hormuz becomes operational, carrying at least one vessel transit between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: The Oman News Agency or the Omani foreign ministry, and the Iranian foreign ministry, both state the corridor is in operation with at least one transit completed before 2026-11-01.
failure_condition: No vessel transits a jointly administered Iran-Oman corridor under an operative agreement on or before 2026-10-31.

statement: United States and Iranian officials hold a direct negotiating session, in person or by video link, between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: The State Department or White House and the Iranian foreign ministry each confirm a direct session inside the window. Relay through Omani or Qatari mediators alone does not count.
failure_condition: All US-Iran contact in the window runs through third-party mediators, with no direct session between the two governments.

statement: OFAC designates at least one foreign-registered company or non-Iranian-flagged vessel for facilitating Iranian oil sales, in an action dated between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: The OFAC Recent Actions page or an SDN list update dated inside the window adds at least one foreign-registered entity or non-Iranian-flagged vessel under an Iran-related program tag.
failure_condition: Every Iran-related OFAC designation dated inside the window names only Iran-based persons, entities, or Iranian-flagged vessels.

statement: CISA catalogues a Microsoft SharePoint vulnerability as actively exploited, with a KEV date-added value between 2026-08-27 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON holds an entry with vendorProject Microsoft, a product string naming SharePoint, and a dateAdded value between 2026-08-27 and 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: No SharePoint entry in the KEV catalog carries a dateAdded value inside that range.

statement: A named extortion group publicly claims the Boston Scientific intrusion by listing the company on a leak site between 2026-08-27 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: At least two of BleepingComputer, Cybersecurity Dive, Reuters, and The Record report a named group listing Boston Scientific on an extortion leak site inside the window.
failure_condition: No named extortion group lists Boston Scientific on a leak site on or before 2026-10-15.

statement: The Bureau of Industry and Security adds a party to the Entity List over diversion of advanced computing items or AI servers to China, published in the Federal Register between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: A Federal Register rule published inside the window adds at least one party to the Entity List with a justification resting on diversion of advanced computing items or AI servers to China.
failure_condition: No Entity List addition published inside the window rests on diversion of advanced computing or AI server items to China.

statement: The confirmed death toll in Nepal from the 2026-08-26 Bhotekoshi and Trishuli flooding reaches 300 or more, stated by a Nepali government body between 2026-08-27 and 2026-10-12.
resolution: The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority, the Home Ministry, or the Office of the Prime Minister of Nepal states a confirmed dead count of 300 or more for this event inside the window.
failure_condition: The Nepali confirmed dead count for this event stays below 300 through 2026-10-12, with the balance still carried as missing.

statement: Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin meet face to face between 2026-09-07 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: The Kremlin press service and the White House both confirm the two met in person on a date inside the window. Phone calls and meetings by delegates do not count.
failure_condition: Trump and Putin do not meet in person on any date inside the window.
